metadata.name: ChangePlan
metadata.description: Purpose of this API is to change credit plan for a transaction.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition: At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber/AccountID is required

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition: At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber/AccountID is required Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber/AccountID is required

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Transaction Number for transaction being posted. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:23654789 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CreditPlanMaster
request_fields.description: New Plan name which need to be updated. Values for credit plan master would be pulled by "GetPromotionBYAmount" API. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:6 Months No Interest if Paid in Full Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: MemoReasonID
request_fields.description: Reason of Memo Text Valid Values:0-9, a-z,special characters Format:XXXXXXXXX Example: New transaction. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MemoText
request_fields.description: Text of the Memo. Valid Values:0-9, a-z,special characters Format:XXXXXXXXX Example: New Transaction posted. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: InterestPlanID
request_fields.description: New Interest Plan Id which needs to be updated on the Plan. Valid Values:0 - 9, A - z,special characters Format:XXXX Example: 1233 Condition: Interest Plan Override setup should be enabled at Plan Master.

request_fields.name: PortfolioID
request_fields.description: Description: Indicates details of lender institution mapped on account. Valid Values: Under special characters only Hypen (-) and Underscore () are allowed. No spaces allowed in between strings. Example: Under special characters only Hypen (-) and Underscore () are allowed. No spaces allowed in between strings.

response_fields.name: CurrencySymbol
response_fields.description: This tag reflects the currency symbol

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PlanSegmentID
children.description: Description: Indicates the unique ID generated for each plan segment added to an account. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:98756775
